meta.description: Registry for ambiguity, bifurcation, collapse, and instability modes arising from continuation selection in the delta operator.

failure_modes.name: selection_instability
failure_modes.description: Erratic switching between continuation candidates under small perturbations.

failure_modes.name: orientation_conflict
failure_modes.description: Multiple candidates satisfy orientation minimization with equal weight, leading to unresolvable ambiguity.

failure_modes.name: branch_explosion
failure_modes.description: Unconstrained multi-branch retention leads to an exponential increase in concurrent process states.

failure_modes.name: residue_divergence
failure_modes.description: Selection logic driven by residue history leads to non-physical state expansion or structural collapse.

failure_modes.name: admissibility_collapse
failure_modes.description: Selection of candidates that results in the immediate collapse of the future admissibility window.

failure_modes.name: non_convergent_selection
failure_modes.description: Selection sequence fails to reach a stable or persistent regime.

failure_modes.name: oscillatory_selection
failure_modes.description: Selection logic results in periodic switching between disparate continuation regimes.

failure_modes.name: selection_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Multiple distinct continuation paths appear identical under the evaluated selection metrics.
